style_guide.name: Neo-Memphis 3.0 (Premium Editorial)
style_guide.description: The evolution of Corporate Memphis. Moving away from flat 2D into a textured, dimensional, and premium editorial aesthetic. Features 'Clay-morphism' volume, digital grain, and sophisticated mesh gradients while maintaining the inclusive foundation of South Asian (Indian) identity standards.

rendering_engine.texture: Procedural grainy digital noise, 15% intensity, matte paper finish
rendering_engine.lighting: Cinematic softbox studio lighting, subtle rim highlights, directional soft shadows with slight amber/blue tints
rendering_engine.shading: Clay-morphic 'inflate' effect (soft 3D volume), no harsh edges, smooth ambient occlusion

figures.identity: Strictly South Asian (Indian) characters. Warm skin tones (golden, chocolate, deep bronze). Authentic urban Indian styling including modern kurtas, linen shirts, and professional tech-wear.
figures.proportions: Elongated limbs, fluid rubber-hose motion, simplified but elegant facial features with expressive curved eyes and sharp but stylized jawlines.
figures.detailing: Subtle fabric textures, translucent fingernails, and soft-focus hair shapes.

environment.elements: Glassmorphic floating UI elements, translucent 3D medical icons, frosted glass textures, organic 3D blobs, and levitating geometric shapes.
environment.background: Deep mesh gradients (e.g., Midnight Blue to Lavender), high-contrast negative space, or soft textured gray studio backdrops.

prompt_logic.negative_prompt: flat 2010s corporate memphis, aliasing, sharp edges, low resolution, caucasian features, neon colors, messy lines, watermark, cluttered background
